A water buffalo of Việt Nam (trâu): a swamp buffalo, about 1.3 m at the withers, dark gray, a wide body, wide horns that curve back.

A swamp buffalo of Việt Nam (trâu): 1.2 to 1.4 m at the withers, 350 to 450 kg, dark gray, horns that curve out and back. The template is a bull without its horns; the numbers of the shape are a guess from photos.
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
